``` {r setup, include=FALSE}
# ==============================================================================
# 0. Global Setup & Libraries
# ==============================================================================
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
options(scipen = 999, digits = 6)

# Install/Load required packages
if(!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
if(!require("here")) install.packages("here") 

pacman::p_load(
  here,          # Path management
  lme4, lmerTest,# Mixed models
  emmeans,       # Marginal means
  DHARMa,        # Residual checks
  ggplot2, dplyr, performance, tibble, broom.mixed, readxl, stringr,
  openxlsx, pwr, effectsize, tidyr, car, scales,
  gridExtra, ggpubr, knitr, buildmer
)

# Contrast coding settings
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
adjust_method <- "fdr"
```

# 1\. Data Import & Preprocessing

``` {r data-import}
cat("========================================\n")
cat("    FACE PHASE DATA LOADING            \n")
cat("========================================\n")

# [Modified] Use Universal Path from Preprocessing
path_input_face <- here("data", "face_phase", "trials.csv")

if(file.exists(path_input_face)) {
  data_face <- read.csv(path_input_face, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  cat("Raw Face Data: ", nrow(data_face), "trials\n")
} else {
  stop("Input file not found at: ", path_input_face)
}

data_face$expressor <- stringr::str_extract(data_face$stim, "(Fema\\d+|Male\\d+)")

# Fix ID format
if(all(grepl("^\\d+$", data_face$participant_id))) {
  data_face$participant_id <- sprintf("Vp%04d", as.numeric(data_face$participant_id))
}

cat("\n========== Loading Baseline Data ==========\n")
# [Modified] Use ROI-specific baseline for Face Phase (LPP_face)
baseline_path <- here("data", "baseline", "LPP_face", "trials.csv")

if(file.exists(baseline_path)) {
  baseline_data <- read.csv(baseline_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  cat("Baseline Data: ", nrow(baseline_data), "trials\n")
  
  if(all(grepl("^\\d+$", baseline_data$participant_id))) {
    baseline_data$participant_id <- sprintf("Vp%04d", as.numeric(baseline_data$participant_id))
  }
  
  data_face$index <- as.integer(data_face$index)
  baseline_data$index <- as.integer(baseline_data$index)

  # Check columns
  cat("Baseline cols:", paste(head(colnames(baseline_data), 5), collapse = ", "), "...\n")
  
  # Try to match 'LPPfacebaseline' or generic 'CPPbaseline'
  baseline_col <- intersect(names(baseline_data), c("LPPfacebaseline", "CPPbaseline"))[1]
  
  if(is.na(baseline_col)) stop("Baseline column not found in baseline file.")
  cat("Using baseline column:", baseline_col, "\n")
  
  data_face <- merge(
    data_face,
    baseline_data[, c("participant_id", "index", baseline_col)],
    by = c("participant_id", "index"),
    all.x = TRUE
  )
  
  # Rename to generic 'Baseline' for model consistency
  data_face$Baseline <- data_face[[baseline_col]]
  
  cat("Merge success rate:", round(mean(!is.na(data_face$Baseline))*100, 2), "%\n")
} else {
  stop("Baseline file not found: ", baseline_path)
}

cat("\n========== Grand Mean Centering (Alday 2019) ==========\n")
# [Modified] NO CWC. Just Grand Mean Centering for convergence.
data_face$Baseline <- as.numeric(scale(data_face$Baseline, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE))
cat("Baseline centered (Mean = 0). No state/trait splitting.\n\n")

# Load Covariates
covariate_path <- here("data", "covariates", "SVO_PID5BF_PostRating.xlsx")
if(file.exists(covariate_path)) {
  covariates <- readxl::read_excel(covariate_path)
  if(all(grepl("^\\d+$", covariates$participant_id))) {
    covariates$participant_id <- sprintf("Vp%04d", as.numeric(covariates$participant_id))
  }
  data_face <- merge(data_face, covariates, by = "participant_id", all.x = TRUE)
}

# Factors
data_face$participant_id <- factor(data_face$participant_id)
data_face$emotion <- factor(data_face$emotion, levels = c("neu", "aff", "dis", "dom", "enj"))
data_face$reaction_label <- factor(
  data_face$reaction, levels = c(0,1,2), labels = c("Miss","Accept","Reject")
)
data_face <- subset(data_face, reaction_label %in% c("Accept","Reject"))

n_subjects <- length(unique(data_face$participant_id))
cat("\nData Ready: ", n_subjects, "subjects,", nrow(data_face), "trials\n")
```

# 2\) Statistical Helper Functions

``` {r analysis-functions}
format_p_apa <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("")
  if (p < 0.001) return("< .001")
  sprintf("= %.3f", p)
}

# ★★★ Simple Slope Analysis (Using 'Baseline') ★★★
perform_simple_slope_analysis <- function(model, data, erp_name, alpha = 0.05) {
  cat("\n  === Simple Slope Analysis ===\n")
  results <- list()
  report_text <- character()
  
  # [Modified] var = "Baseline"
  slopes <- emtrends(model, ~ emotion, var = "Baseline")
  slopes_df <- as.data.frame(slopes)
  results[["Simple_Slopes"]] <- slopes_df
  
  report_text <- c(report_text, "\n=== SIMPLE SLOPES OF BASELINE ===\n")
  
  slopes_test <- test(slopes, adjust = "none")
  slopes_test_df <- as.data.frame(slopes_test)
  results[["Simple_Slopes_Tests"]] <- slopes_test_df
  
  for(i in 1:nrow(slopes_test_df)) {
    sig_flag <- ifelse(slopes_test_df$p.value[i] < alpha, "***", "n.s.")
    report_text <- c(report_text,
      sprintf("  %s: slope = %.4f, SE = %.4f, t = %.2f, p %s %s",
              slopes_test_df$emotion[i],
              slopes_test_df$Baseline.trend[i],
              slopes_test_df$SE[i],
              slopes_test_df$t.ratio[i],
              format_p_apa(slopes_test_df$p.value[i]),
              sig_flag))
  }
  
  report_text <- c(report_text, "\n--- Pairwise Slope Comparisons ---")
  slope_contrasts <- contrast(slopes, method = "pairwise", adjust = adjust_method)
  slope_contrasts_df <- as.data.frame(slope_contrasts)
  results[["Slope_Contrasts"]] <- slope_contrasts_df
  
  sig_contrasts <- subset(slope_contrasts_df, p.value < 0.05)
  if(nrow(sig_contrasts) > 0) {
    report_text <- c(report_text, "  Significant Slope Diffs (FDR):")
    for(j in 1:nrow(sig_contrasts)) {
      report_text <- c(report_text,
        sprintf("    %s: Δslope = %.4f, t = %.2f, p %s",
                sig_contrasts$contrast[j],
                sig_contrasts$estimate[j],
                sig_contrasts$t.ratio[j],
                format_p_apa(sig_contrasts$p.value[j])))
    }
  } else {
    report_text <- c(report_text, "  No significant slope differences")
  }
  
  list(results = results, report = paste(report_text, collapse = "\n"))
}

# ★★★ Interaction Decomposition (Emotion x Baseline) ★★★
perform_interaction_decomposition <- function(model, data, erp_name, anova_result, model_type) {
  results <- list()
  report_text <- character()

  model_terms <- attr(terms(model), "term.labels")
  # [Modified] Check for 'Baseline' interactions
  has_interaction <- "emotion:Baseline" %in% model_terms
  has_baseline <- "Baseline" %in% model_terms

  p_intx <- if(has_interaction) anova_result["emotion:Baseline", "Pr(>F)"] else NA_real_

  if(has_interaction && !is.na(p_intx)) {
    report_text <- c(report_text, "\n=== EMOTION × BASELINE INTERACTION ===")
    if(p_intx < 0.05) {
      cat("\n  *** Interaction Significant (p", format_p_apa(p_intx), ") ***\n")
      report_text <- c(
        report_text,
        sprintf("\nEmotion × Baseline significant: F(%d, %.0f) = %.2f, p %s",
          anova_result["emotion:Baseline", "NumDF"],
          anova_result["emotion:Baseline", "DenDF"],
          anova_result["emotion:Baseline", "F value"],
          format_p_apa(p_intx)
        )
      )

      slope_analysis <- perform_simple_slope_analysis(model, data, erp_name)
      results <- c(results, slope_analysis$results)
      report_text <- c(report_text, slope_analysis$report)

      report_text <- c(report_text, "\n\n=== PROBING AT ±0.5SD ===")
      
      # [Modified] Use Baseline statistics
      baseline_sd <- sd(data$Baseline, na.rm = TRUE)
      baseline_levels <- c(-0.5 * baseline_sd, 0, 0.5 * baseline_sd)
      baseline_labels <- c("Low_BL_05SD", "Mean_BL", "High_BL_05SD")

      cat("\n  Probing at:", round(baseline_levels, 2), "μV\n")

      probe_results <- list()
      for(i in seq_along(baseline_levels)) {
        bl_val <- baseline_levels[i]; bl_label <- baseline_labels[i]
        
        emm_at_baseline <- emmeans(model, ~ emotion, at = list(Baseline = bl_val))
        probe_results[[bl_label]] <- as.data.frame(emm_at_baseline)
        
        simple_main <- joint_tests(emm_at_baseline)
        if(nrow(simple_main) > 0) {
          p_simple <- simple_main$p.value[1]
          report_text <- c(report_text,
            sprintf("\n%s (%.2f μV): Emotion effect F = %.2f, p %s",
                    bl_label, bl_val, simple_main$F.ratio[1],
                    format_p_apa(p_simple)))
                    
          if(p_simple < 0.05) {
            pairs_simple <- pairs(emm_at_baseline, adjust = adjust_method)
            results[[paste0("Emotion_pairs_at_", bl_label)]] <- as.data.frame(pairs_simple)
          }
        }
      }
      
      results[["Probe_Results"]] <- probe_results

      return(list(results = results, report = paste(report_text, collapse = "\n"),
                  type = "interaction_significant", 
                  baseline_levels = baseline_levels,
                  baseline_labels = baseline_labels))
    } else {
      cat("\n  Interaction not significant (p", format_p_apa(p_intx), ")\n")
      report_text <- c(report_text, sprintf("\nInteraction ns: p %s", format_p_apa(p_intx)))
    }
  }

  cat("\n  Analyzing Main Effects...\n")
  report_text <- c(report_text, "\n=== MAIN EFFECTS ===")

  if("emotion" %in% rownames(anova_result)) {
    p_emotion <- anova_result["emotion", "Pr(>F)"]
    if(!is.na(p_emotion) && p_emotion < 0.05) {
      context <- if(has_baseline) "(controlling for baseline)" else ""
      report_text <- c(report_text,
        sprintf("\nMain effect of emotion %s: F(%d, %.0f) = %.2f, p %s",
                context,
                anova_result["emotion", "NumDF"],
                anova_result["emotion", "DenDF"],
                anova_result["emotion", "F value"],
                format_p_apa(p_emotion)))
      
      emm_emotion <- emmeans(model, ~ emotion)
      results[["Emotion_EMMs"]] <- as.data.frame(emm_emotion)
      pairs_emotion <- pairs(emm_emotion, adjust = adjust_method)
      results[["Emotion_Pairwise"]] <- as.data.frame(pairs_emotion)
    }
  }

  list(results = results, report = paste(report_text, collapse = "\n"), type = "main_effects")
}

# ★★★ Visualization Function ★★★
create_publication_plots <- function(model, data, erp_name, model_name, output_dir, decomposition) {
  cat("    Generating plots...\n")
  emotion_colors <- c('neu'='#999999', 'aff'='#56B4E9', 'dis'='#E69F00',
                      'dom'='#CC79A7', 'enj'='#009E73')
  emotion_labels <- c('neu'='Neutral', 'aff'='Affiliative', 'dis'='Disgust',
                      'dom'='Dominance', 'enj'='Enjoyment')

  subtitle_text <- "Face Phase Analysis"

  # Main Effect Plot
  emm <- emmeans(model, ~ emotion)
  emm_df <- as.data.frame(emm)
  if("emmean" %in% names(emm_df)) {
    emm_df$mean <- emm_df$emmean
    emm_df$se   <- emm_df$SE
  }
  emm_df$ci_lower <- emm_df$mean - 1.96 * emm_df$se
  emm_df$ci_upper <- emm_df$mean + 1.96 * emm_df$se

  p_main <- ggplot(emm_df, aes(x = emotion, y = mean, fill = emotion)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "black", size = 0.3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), width = 0.2, size = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = emotion_colors, labels = emotion_labels, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = emotion_labels) +
    labs(title = paste0(erp_name, " - ", model_name),
         subtitle = subtitle_text,
         x = "Facial Expression", y = paste0(erp_name, " Amplitude (μV)")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.3))

  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(erp_name, "_", model_name, "_main.png")),
         plot = p_main, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)

  if (decomposition$type == "interaction_significant") {
    
    # ★★★ 3-Panel Probe Plot ★★★
    probe_data_list <- decomposition$results$Probe_Results
    baseline_labels <- decomposition$baseline_labels
    baseline_levels <- decomposition$baseline_levels
    
    probe_df_all <- data.frame()
    for(i in seq_along(baseline_labels)) {
      probe_df <- probe_data_list[[baseline_labels[i]]]
      if("emmean" %in% names(probe_df)) {
        probe_df$mean <- probe_df$emmean
        probe_df$se <- probe_df$SE
      }
      probe_df$baseline_level <- baseline_labels[i]
      probe_df$baseline_value <- baseline_levels[i]
      probe_df_all <- rbind(probe_df_all, probe_df)
    }
    
    probe_df_all$ci_lower <- probe_df_all$mean - 1.96 * probe_df_all$se
    probe_df_all$ci_upper <- probe_df_all$mean + 1.96 * probe_df_all$se
    
    probe_df_all$baseline_label <- factor(
      probe_df_all$baseline_level,
      levels = baseline_labels,
      labels = c(
        sprintf("Low Baseline\n(-0.5SD, %.1fμV)", baseline_levels[1]),
        sprintf("Mean Baseline\n(0μV)"),
        sprintf("High Baseline\n(+0.5SD, %.1fμV)", baseline_levels[3])
      )
    )
    
    p_three_panel <- ggplot(probe_df_all, aes(x = emotion, y = mean, fill = emotion)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.75, color = "black", size = 0.3) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), width = 0.25, size = 0.6) +
      facet_wrap(~ baseline_label, nrow = 1) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = emotion_colors, labels = emotion_labels) +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = emotion_labels) +
      labs(title = paste0(erp_name, " - Baseline-Dependent Emotion Effects"),
           x = "Facial Expression", 
           y = paste0(erp_name, " Amplitude (μV)"),
           fill = "Emotion") +
      theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom",
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8))
    
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(erp_name, "_", model_name, "_three_panel.png")),
           plot = p_three_panel, width = 12, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
    
    # ★★★ Continuous Plot ★★★
    # [Modified] Use 'Baseline' variable range
    baseline_seq <- seq(quantile(data$Baseline, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
                       quantile(data$Baseline, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
                       length.out = 100)
    
    pred_list <- list()
    for(emo in levels(data$emotion)) {
      # Create prediction grid using 'Baseline'
      pred_data <- data.frame(
        emotion = factor(emo, levels = levels(data$emotion)),
        Baseline = baseline_seq,
        participant_id = factor(data$participant_id[1], levels = levels(data$participant_id))
      )
      pred_data$predicted <- predict(model, newdata = pred_data, re.form = NA)
      
      mm <- model.matrix(delete.response(terms(model)), pred_data)
      pred_data$se <- sqrt(diag(mm %*% vcov(model) %*% t(mm)))
      pred_data$ci_lower <- pred_data$predicted - 1.96 * pred_data$se
      pred_data$ci_upper <- pred_data$predicted + 1.96 * pred_data$se
      
      pred_list[[emo]] <- pred_data
    }
    pred_all <- do.call(rbind, pred_list)
    
    p_continuous <- ggplot(pred_all, aes(x = Baseline, y = predicted,
                                         color = emotion, fill = emotion)) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
      geom_line(size = 1) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", size = 0.5) +
      scale_color_manual(values = emotion_colors, labels = emotion_labels) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = emotion_colors, labels = emotion_labels) +
      labs(title = paste0(erp_name, " - Continuous Baseline Moderation"),
           x = "Baseline Amplitude (μV)",
           y = paste0(erp_name, " Amplitude (μV)"),
           color = "Emotion", fill = "Emotion") +
      theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom")
    
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(erp_name, "_", model_name, "_continuous.png")),
           plot = p_continuous, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
    
    # ★★★ Slopes Plot ★★★
    if("Simple_Slopes" %in% names(decomposition$results)) {
      slopes_df <- decomposition$results$Simple_Slopes
      slopes_df$ci_lower <- slopes_df$Baseline.trend - 1.96 * slopes_df$SE
      slopes_df$ci_upper <- slopes_df$Baseline.trend + 1.96 * slopes_df$SE
      
      p_slopes <- ggplot(slopes_df, aes(x = emotion, y = Baseline.trend, fill = emotion)) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
        geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "black", size = 0.3) +
        geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), width = 0.2, size = 0.7) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = emotion_colors, labels = emotion_labels, guide = "none") +
        scale_x_discrete(labels = emotion_labels) +
        labs(title = paste0(erp_name, " - Simple Slopes of Baseline"),
             x = "Facial Expression",
             y = "Baseline Slope (beta)") +
        theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
      
      ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(erp_name, "_", model_name, "_slopes.png")),
             plot = p_slopes, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
    }
  }
}
```

# 3\) Main Analysis Loop

``` {r main-analysis}
get_final_mermod <- function(bm_obj) {
  if (inherits(bm_obj, "buildmer")) {
    if (!is.null(bm_obj@model)) return(bm_obj@model)
    if (!is.null(bm_obj@mer))   return(bm_obj@mer)
  }
  bm_obj
}

analyze_erp_component <- function(data, erp_name) {
  cat("\n================================================\n")
  cat("  Analyzing Component:", erp_name, "\n")
  cat("================================================\n")

  # [Modified] Universal Path
  base_dir <- here("results", "Face_Phase")
  output_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "Results_Alday", erp_name)
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  df_analysis <- data[!is.na(data[[erp_name]]) & !is.na(data$Baseline), ]

  cat("\nData Points: ", nrow(df_analysis), "trials, ",
      length(unique(df_analysis$participant_id)), "subjects\n")

  # [Modified] Alday (2019) Models (using 'Baseline' variable)
  models <- list(
    No_Baseline          = paste0(erp_name, " ~ emotion + (1 | participant_id)"),
    Baseline_Additive    = paste0(erp_name, " ~ emotion + Baseline + (1 | participant_id)"),
    Full_Interaction     = paste0(erp_name, " ~ emotion * Baseline + (1 | participant_id)")
  )

  cat("\n========== Model Fitting ==========\n")
  
  fitted_models <- list()
  for(model_name in names(models)) {
    cat("\nFitting:", model_name, "... ")
    form_str <- models[[model_name]]
    tryCatch({
      model <- lmer(as.formula(form_str), data = df_analysis, REML = FALSE)
      fitted_models[[model_name]] <- model
      cat("OK")
    }, error = function(e) cat("Error:", e$message))
  }
  if(length(fitted_models) == 0) stop("No models converged.")

  # M4 Buildmer (Maximal Random Effects)
  cat("\nFitting Model_4_buildmer... ")
  form_bm <- as.formula(paste0(erp_name, " ~ emotion * Baseline + (emotion | participant_id)")) 
  tryCatch({
    bm_res <- buildmer::buildmer(form_bm, data = df_analysis, 
                                 buildmerControl = buildmerControl(direction = c("order","backward"), elim = LRTalpha(0.2)))
    fitted_models[["Model_4_buildmer_final"]] <- get_final_mermod(bm_res)
    cat("OK\n")
  }, error = function(e) cat("Error"))

  cat("\n\n========== Detailed Analysis ==========\n")
  all_results <- list()

  for(model_name in names(fitted_models)) {
    model <- fitted_models[[model_name]]
    cat("\n--- Processing Model:", model_name, "---\n")
    model_dir <- file.path(output_dir, model_name)
    dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

    anova_result <- anova(model)
    write.csv(anova_result, file.path(model_dir, "ANOVA.csv"))
    
    anova_type3 <- car::Anova(model, type = 3)
    write.csv(anova_type3, file.path(model_dir, "ANOVA_TypeIII.csv"))
    
    try({
      eta_tab <- effectsize::eta_squared(anova_type3, partial = TRUE, ci = 0.90)
      write.csv(eta_tab, file.path(model_dir, "EffectSizes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    }, silent = TRUE)
    
    decomposition <- perform_interaction_decomposition(
      model, df_analysis, erp_name, anova_result, model_type = model_name
    )

    for(result_name in names(decomposition$results)) {
      result_data <- decomposition$results[[result_name]]
      if(is.data.frame(result_data)) {
        write.csv(result_data, file.path(model_dir, paste0(result_name, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
      }
    }

    create_publication_plots(model, df_analysis, erp_name, model_name, model_dir, decomposition)

    sink(file.path(model_dir, "model_summary.txt"))
    cat("Model:", model_name, "\n")
    print(summary(model))
    cat("\n--- Decomposition ---\n")
    cat(decomposition$report)
    sink()

    all_results[[model_name]] <- decomposition
  }

  # Excel
  cat("\n\n========== Excel Report ==========\n")
  wb <- createWorkbook()
  
  comp_df <- data.frame(Model=names(fitted_models), AIC=sapply(fitted_models, AIC), BIC=sapply(fitted_models, BIC))
  comp_df <- comp_df[order(comp_df$AIC),]
  comp_df$deltaAIC <- comp_df$AIC - min(comp_df$AIC)
  addWorksheet(wb, "Comparison"); writeData(wb, "Comparison", comp_df)

  excel_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(erp_name, "_Results.xlsx"))
  saveWorkbook(wb, excel_file, overwrite = TRUE)
  cat("Saved:", excel_file, "\n")
}
```
